chunks: From Yazid ibn Khalifah from Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah, Blessed and Exalted, decrees for a believer any decree, but He makes the good in what He has decreed.
ai.seo_question: What does Allah make for a believer in whatever He decrees?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the nature of divine decree (qada) for believers, asserting that whatever Allah decrees for them contains inherent goodness. It emphasizes that divine will is not arbitrary but is always beneficial for the faithful, even if the immediate perception of that benefit is not clear.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 24. It has been narrated that Yazid ibn Khalifah said that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s)
said: Allah never decrees anything for a believer but that He makes His decree the best for him.
